title: my first codex + aseprite experiment: living world fx - free 32x32 urban environmental vfx pack
author: Derefringence
selftext:
i’ve been experimenting with codex as part of an aseprite-based pixel art workflow, and this is the first finished result.

living world fx — urban starter pack is a free set of 14 environmental effects + 12 neon variants: steam, exhaust, rain, water, dust, sparks and neon (RGB + straight + circular variants).

no generative image model or generated image source material was used. the sprites were built as pixel data in aseprite, with a lot of iteration, review and revision along the way.

free download:

https://zimraz.itch.io/living-world-fx-urban-starter

i’d especially be interested in what non-fantasy environmental effects people usually have trouble finding, very grateful to hear what you guys think!

thanks everyone in advance for even considering taking a look in this  glorious age of oversaturation.
